preconditions.description: The input s is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string contains only letters, spaces, and parentheses.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(c for i, c in enumerate(s) if not (s.find('(', 0, i+1) != -1 and s.find(')', i) != -1 and s.find('(', 0, i+1) < i < s.find(')', i)))
postconditions.description: The output is the input string with all characters inside parentheses (including the parentheses themselves) removed.

postconditions.expression: not any(c in return_value for c in '()')
postconditions.description: The output string contains no parentheses.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only letters and spaces.
